about: Data-gap lengths (true-scale lane, motion pass 3): typical healthy wild adult, both sexes averaged; hb = head and body (no tail) for mammals, snout-vent for lizards and crocodiles, carapace for turtles, the whole animal otherwise; total = to the tail tip; mass in kg. Written 2026-11-12 by Claude Code agents from their own knowledge (no API, no web), in the data-gap work's way (AnimalDex ark-data-gaps): generated, kept apart from stored values and labelled. Used only where the catalogue stores no length, and as the check on stored ones.
